# DevelopmentalNeuromorphicAdaptation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design principle where neuromorphic systems reconfigure their topology based on developmental or clinical feedback, mimicking brain plasticity. Enables self-optimizing in-network architectures that respond to changing inputs, crucial for long-term brain-health applications.
